_note: Shared by the web scanner (lib/scanner) and the repo audit toolkit (toolkit/). Each pattern is a JS RegExp source string; severity is critical|high|medium|low.

patterns.name: Stripe live secret key
patterns.fix: Roll the key in the Stripe dashboard now, then move all Stripe secret-key calls to a server function (Supabase Edge Function or API route) and read the key from an environment variable.

patterns.name: Stripe live restricted key
patterns.fix: Roll the key in Stripe and call Stripe only from server code.

patterns.name: Stripe test secret key
patterns.fix: Test keys can't move real money, but their presence means live keys will probably end up here too. Move Stripe secret calls to server code.

patterns.name: Stripe webhook signing secret
patterns.fix: Roll the webhook secret in Stripe and keep it only in server environment variables.

patterns.name: OpenAI API key
patterns.fix: Revoke the key at platform.openai.com, set a spend limit, and proxy AI calls through a server function.

patterns.name: Anthropic API key
patterns.fix: Revoke the key in the Anthropic Console and proxy AI calls through a server function.

patterns.name: Google API key
patterns.fix: Google API keys are often meant to be public (Firebase, Maps), but restrict them by HTTP referrer and API in Google Cloud. If this key can call Gemini or other paid APIs, revoke it.

patterns.name: AWS access key ID
patterns.fix: Deactivate the key in AWS IAM immediately and check CloudTrail for misuse.

patterns.name: GitHub token
patterns.fix: Revoke the token in GitHub settings.

patterns.name: Resend API key
patterns.fix: Revoke it in Resend and send email from server code only.

patterns.name: SendGrid API key
patterns.fix: Revoke it in SendGrid and send email from server code only.

patterns.name: Twilio API key SID
patterns.fix: If this is a Twilio API key, revoke it and call Twilio from server code only.

patterns.name: Slack incoming webhook
patterns.fix: Anyone can post into your Slack with this URL. Regenerate it and call it from server code.

patterns.name: Private key block
patterns.fix: Treat the key as compromised, rotate it, and never ship private keys to the browser.

patterns.name: Mailgun API key
patterns.fix: If this is a Mailgun key, revoke it and send email from server code.
